headline: AI-driven growth lifts top performers while margin pressure and modest guidance temper the sector.
summary: Revenue grew across the board, led by Coforge's 53.6% surge and strong AI‑led wins at LTM, Mphasis and HCLTech. Profitability improved for most, but Infosys trimmed FY27 guidance and Wipro saw profit dip. Operating margins widened for HCLTech and TCS, while OFSS posted a very high margin on modest growth.

themes.title: AI as a growth engine
themes.detail: AI revenue rose sharply at several firms, driving double‑digit profit growth and large deal wins.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance; other peers kept guidance unchanged or introduced modest targets.

themes.title: Margin dynamics
themes.detail: Operating margins improved at HCLTech (18.2%) and TCS (24%), while OFSS maintained a high margin on low growth.

leaders.why: Revenue jumped 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
13.6% revenue growth and AI revenue surged 47% YoY.

laggards.why: Revenue data missing and net profit fell 1.9% YoY.
Guidance cut to 1‑2% FY27 growth despite only modest 1.5% revenue rise.

domain_outlook.note: Mphasis highlighted telecom and device engineering as a growth driver.
